_what: The shape of a streamed answer (src/keyed-parts.mjs): an entry is keyed parts, each with a type from this table. `merge` says what a new event of that type does to the part already under its key: append (its `text` is added), replace (its `value` is the part), patch (its `ops` change the value of the part named by `target`). Adding a part type is a row here. `resume.max_stalls` is how many re-attach attempts in a row may bring nothing new before the client gives up; `snapshot_type` is the event a re-attach answers with.

words.unknown_type: {type} is not a part type this reader knows; the part was kept as it came.
words.patch_failed: A change to {target} did not apply ({why}); it was added as its own part.
words.gave_up: The answer stopped arriving after {count} tries.
